items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: I heard him, the first place I ever heard him playing outside of a house was out there at the West End Tavis.

ctx.x: Piano player, yeah. I heard him, the first place I ever heard him playing outside of a house was out there at the West End Tavis. Out there on the Pulse Train Boulevard back then. That was years ago, though. Not right, not lately. An old man out there.
Do you remember Lincoln Park or Johnson Park when you were a kid? Yeah. Did you ever go out there? What was it like? Do you remember anything?
